ns0:svg.ns0:title: Tuvok Leaflet — editable SVG
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Editable vector reconstruction of Tuvok leaflet overlay over linked leaflet artwork. Text, colored panel frames, header bars, and legend are vectors; token and die symbols link to individual assets. Raster icon instances replaced with embedded SVG vector shapes; original text preserved.

ns0:text.ns0:tspan: They must reveal their hand to you.
before their first reroll. You can control their first
reroll attempt or force them to skip it.
(This token may not be removed or transferred by any means.)

ns0:g.ns0:text: You may activate one of these effects per turn.
Spend x: During any Roll Phase add x
Spend 2: During Upkeep Phase look at the top card
of your deck. Put it back on top or bottom

ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Two overlapping rounded playing cards, drawn with editable vector shapes. The front card contains an editable number.

ns0:g.ns0:text: When a player afflicted with this token is attacked by
an opponent, the attacker increases their damage by 2.
This is an Attack Modifier and persists until removed.
A player with this token may spend it at any time to
prevent half of their incoming damage, rounded up. If
two Protect tokens are spent against the same attack,
both independently halve the damage. Protect gained
from a Defensive Ability may be spent immediately.
